row.proto: void Sess_Tod_BuildSessionDataset_Thunk(void *tod_owner, const uint8_t *types, const float *hold_s, const float *trans_s, const uint8_t *random, uint32_t count, float len_s, uint16_t session, uint8_t use_count)
row.notes: thunk=jmp to .data1 body 0x155755570 (plaintext on Steam). 9-arg layout (V0246, V0313): rcx=*(ws+0x1da8) TOD owner (TOD=*(owner+0x2d0)), rdx=u8 engine types[6] (clear..stormy, 0x145bf6358), r8=f32 hold s[6], r9=f32 transition s[6], [rsp+20]=u8 random[6], [rsp+28]=u32 count, [rsp+30]=f32 dataset length s, [rsp+38]=u16 0x100|dataset (<0x100 = all 10 datasets, 0x14588c605), [rsp+40]=u8 use_count flag (0 = one state, else min(count,6)). Body sets TOD+0xb350+s*4 = len and TOD+0x34c+s*0x288 = max(len,0.01), then 0x14461bb70 -> body 0x155254f20, which does nothing if TOD+0xb432 is set or TOD+0xb429/+0xb42a is clear, else Tod_Build_WeatherScenario 0x14461bea0(tod,types,hold,trans,random,count,s,use,0), except that with TOD+0xb436 set it diverts when TOD+0xb42d is set (random build with null hold/trans: count rand()%n + 1, n = clamp(TOD+0xb408, 1, 6) with use_count set and 1 otherwise, every random flag set by memset 0x145378b60, worker arg9 = 1) or else when TOD+0x2654 is set (0x14461b3d0); with +0xb436 set and both clear it runs the normal build (V0313). With TOD+0xb426 set and both arrays non-null: state end=(acc+hold)/len, trans=trans/len, no extra states. Callers: setupSession (2 sites) and 0x1428c1ce0 (frontend scene: dataset 0 clear). career-editor checks the same gates (TimeOfDaySystem busy, ready_a/ready_b, override_active && (random_override || scripted_scenario)) before calling and reports not_applied with the reason.  | std-libs 2026-11-18 (static, Steam 1.0.145, for the core weather rebuild): the thunk 0x14479f0d0 jumps to body 0x154e5da90. Against KB body 0x155755570 it aligns 117 of KB's 121 instructions against its 120; the two differences are obfuscation on the single-slot path (KB's junk byte store 0x155755686 and XOR-decoded 0x288 stride 0x155755699-0x1557556a5, 1.0.145's junk qword copy 0x154e5dba6 and plain imul 0x154e5dbc0), and +0xb350 (4 uses), +0x34c (4) and owner+0x2d0 sit at aligned instructions in the same order. Its callee 0x14461e3e0 jumps to 0x15494af60 (KB 0x14461bb70 -> 0x155254f20): 170 of KB's 178 instructions aligned-equal against 1.0.145's 180, both builds carrying filler, with +0xb432 (3 uses), +0xb429, +0xb42a, +0xb436, +0xb42d, +0x2654 and the +0xb427 store at aligned instructions in the same order. The gate 0x14477c570 -> 0x154e0c960 is 142 of 147 against 143. Tod_Build_WeatherScenario 0x14461bea0 -> 0x14461e710: 783/783 equal, +0xb426 2 uses at the same place (sigport --witness). sigport finds no unique pattern for the .data1 bodies, so they were compared by following the jmps (scratch bodycmp.py, rip and branch targets masked).

V0313 Thunk jmp 0x155755570, 9-arg layout (body frame 8 pushes+0x78: [rsp+0xe0..0x100]), type table 0x145bf6358 clear..stormy, 10-dataset table 0x14588c605, len/0.01 stores, 0x14461bb70 gates +0xb432/+0xb429/+0xb42a, exact-timing formula (0x14461bea0) and the 3 callers check. V0876 sigcheck OK; jmp 0x155755570; body frame 8 pushes + 0x78 reads [rsp+0xe0] random, +0xe8 count, +0xf0 len float, +0xf8 u16 session, +0x100 u8 use; session < 0x100 loops the 10 datasets 0x14588c605; sets TOD+0xb350+s*4 = len and +0x34c+s*0x288 = max(len, 0.01); 0x14461bb70 -> 0x155254f20 returns on +0xb432 or !+0xb429 or !+0xb42a, diverts with +0xb436 only on +0xb42d (random 1..min(+0xb408,6)-state build, null hold/trans, last arg 1) or +0x2654 (0x14461b3d0), else 0x14461bea0(..,0); exact timing with +0xb426; callers 0x1428c2a2a (dataset 0x100, count 1, 7200 s), 0x1438b7724, 0x1438b833a. The career-editor clause is addon behaviour, not checked
